Northgate Events: App Store listing

Everything you need at the show, in your pocket. Browse the full attendee directory and filter by company, role or country. Each profile shows a name, job title, company and photo. Book a time with other attendees through the in-app meeting program. Exhibitors can scan badges with the lead retrieval tool and see their leads in the app. Requires iOS 16 or later. Free to download for registered attendees.
